legTips.text: Pack your passport in your carry-on!
Check in online 24 hours before flight.
Buy a Suica or Pasmo card for easy train travel.
Remember to walk on the left side of the street.
Don't leave a tip at restaurants; it's not customary in Japan.

legTips.text: Use your contactless card for the Tube (Oyster card not strictly needed).
Stand on the right on escalators!
Pack an umbrella, rain is always possible.

Steak Frites at Le Relais de l'Entrecôte

legTips.text: Learn a few basic French phrases (Bonjour, Merci).
Beware of pickpockets around major tourist sites like the Eiffel Tower.
Museum passes can save you a lot of money if you plan to visit many.
Taxis are relatively cheap and the easiest way to get around.
Declare all food items at Australian customs!
